title: A7M4 6.02 silent imager-control sink experiment
scope: Consume and retain the AP's one-way type-5 imager-control records for CP endpoint 0x90030001. This models the missing receiver boundary only. It sends no completion, produces no sensor/ISP state, fills no stream2 buffer and creates no liveview frame.
why: The AP IWrapperImaging path sends 0x40xx/0x41xx control records with source 0x80020002 to CP endpoint 0x90030001 via osal_snd_msg. The emulator had no receiver, so UIPC dropped them and logged 'Skip snd to 0x1'. The send API and wire shape establish no synchronous completion contract.

implementation.retention_file_in_guest: /tmp/a7m4-imager-control.bin (4-byte little-endian length + exact message bytes, 262144-byte cap)

test_image.name: imager-control-test.cpio
test_image.profile: stable-equivalent card profile, test name, --auto-main only (no --card-main)

runtime_result.panel_status_after: 原厂界面运行中；省电已关闭；取景和照片保存尚未实现

browser_verification.engine: local Chrome headless over CDP (no browser MCP configured)
browser_verification.final_state: 原厂界面运行中；省电已关闭；取景和照片保存尚未实现

watch.meaning: main-UI card indicator blink, not liveview

limitations: No liveview, sensor, ISP, AF, JPEG or photo path is produced or claimed.
No completion is sent for the consumed one-way imager-control records.
The AP IWrapperImaging thread still waits on queue 0x80020002; the actual imaging event/frame producer is missing.
/dev/stream2 maps reserved guest physical memory, but no producer fills it; no test pattern was injected.
The unmodeled ReleaseLock 0x4037 path still produces the three 0x193 UIPC skips.
This experimental image was not promoted over main-virtual-card-stable.cpio; the test instance was stopped after verification.
